svg.text: 39 firms in 19 components unconnected to the main graph

g.text: 212 firms, 601 interlocks, 20 components (largest 173). Node area is weighted degree; the 11 best-connected are labelled. The other 83 firms in this territory's bundle share no
director with another and so have no place in an interlock network.
